finding: Historical work-admission recovery has three route mismatches: pre-push correctly blocks a critical emergency commit without forward attestation, but `git recover-push-fail` reports the lane as retryable without surfacing the attestation blocker; `git attest` is implemented and referenced by the error-code registry but is absent from `git --help`; and the generated fixed-path attestation ledger can pass `git record-commit --dry-run` but fail the real commit hook as a cross-task mutation owned by TASK-GIT-0024.
expectedBehavior: Protected-push recovery should preserve the exact pre-push blocker and emit the actionable `git attest` command. The help surface should list `attest`. The generated attestation ledger should have a governed commit path that is consistent between dry-run and write, or should use a task-neutral authority path that does not masquerade as active TASK-GIT-0024 ownership.
evidenceOrRepro: During ATM-GOV-0244 push after emergency commit 34f50a551, `node atm.mjs git push --actor codex-git-series-captain --branch main --remote origin --json` failed with ATM_WRITE_TICKET_HISTORICAL_ATTESTATION_REQUIRED. `node atm.mjs git recover-push-fail ... --json` returned ATM_GIT_POST_PUSH_FAIL_ALLOW/retry-after-no-op instead of attestation guidance. `node atm.mjs git attest ...` succeeded and wrote `.atm/history/evidence/TASK-GIT-0024.historical-work-admission-attestations.json`, but `node atm.mjs git record-commit --actor codex-git-series-captain --message ... --json` failed with ATM_CROSS_TASK_MUTATION_BLOCKED after its dry-run accepted the same single staged file.
followUp: Add a generic historical-attestation recovery task: thread pre-push hook failures into recover-push-fail, expose `git attest` in command specs/help, and make attestation-ledger record commits use a task-neutral or explicitly attested authority lane with parity between dry-run and write.
